[[File:Wampastuffedanimal.jpg|thumb|A Wampa stuffed animal]]
The '''Wampa stuffed animal''' was a house object that offered denizens the chance to enjoy all the soft and cuddly aspects of the [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] without the inherent dangers of being taken back to one of the beast's lairs and eaten for dinner. When its stomach was poked, the animal would emit a distinctive "roar."
